title: COPY / COPY
summary: Two words that read COPY are drawn from the same glyphs but different alphabets — a perfect, invisible, un-normalizable copy.
mechanism: Unicode confusables (Latin vs Cyrillic homoglyphs) render identically while JS string comparison and normalize() expose a permanent byte-level difference the eye and paper cannot see.
references: Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
